title: Kimi cli: pyasn1 has quadratic CPU use in schemaless BER/CER/DER container decoding (CVE-2026-119194)
description: CVE-2026-119194 is a high-severity vulnerability in the pyasn1 library used by kimi-cli, where schemaless decoding of BER, CER, or DER data with many distinct long tag IDs causes quadratic CPU usage. This can lead to excessive CPU consumption and reduced availability when processing attacker-controlled inputs. The vulnerability affects versions >=0.56. No confidentiality or integrity impacts have been observed.
